# Opening up language models to see how they actually work

Models are increasingly trusted with real decisions, yet we can rarely see *why* they say what they say. This blog takes concrete problem statements about model behaviour and tests them directly inside open models, using interpretability tools, with all the code published so anyone can reproduce it.

::: {.hero-actions}
[Read the posts](#latest-posts){.btn .btn-primary}
[About this project](about.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}
:::

::: {.pillars}
::: {.pillar}
### Where knowledge lives
Tracing at which layer a model "knows" a fact, and what it was considering before.
:::

::: {.pillar}
### Why models behave as they do
Finding the internal features and circuits behind refusals, sycophancy and mistakes.
:::

::: {.pillar}
### Steering and control
Testing whether changing what's inside a model changes what it does.
:::
